dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins exhibit a smooth, continuous convex curvature with no visible localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white across the entire visible dorsal area, with high median pixel intensity.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of several faint, thin, linear light-colored marks on the central-left dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple superficial, linear epidermal scratches (rake marks) visible on the mid-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge casting a sharp shadow along the right lateral-dorsal axis; blowhole visible at the anterior apex.
